stem: How many **dorsal extensor compartments** are there at the wrist, and which tendons occupy the **first** compartment?

images.caption: Six dorsal extensor compartments at the wrist
images.alt: Cross-section of the dorsal wrist showing six extensor compartments

options.text: Six compartments; first contains APL and EPB
Four compartments; first contains ECRL and ECRB
Six compartments; first contains EPL alone
Five compartments; first contains FCR and PL

explanation: There are **six** dorsal extensor compartments. The **first** contains **abductor pollicis longus (APL)** and **extensor pollicis brevis (EPB)** — the tendons involved in **de Quervain tenosynovitis**. (Compartment 3 holds EPL, which turns around Lister's tubercle; compartment 2 holds ECRL/ECRB.)
references: Netter, Atlas of Human Anatomy — Wrist
